description.value: Jim's Pizzeria and Spaghetti House is a well-established Chilliwack pizza and pasta spot known for dough made in-house daily and house sauce using local tomatoes. The broad menu covers specialty pizzas, lasagna, spaghetti, wings, and salads, with a dedicated gluten-free and vegan section. The business has two Chilliwack locations and offers both dine-in and delivery, making it a substantial meal stop for cyclists moving through the Fraser Valley.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and confirms an active restaurant at 9218 Young Road, matching the OSM address. The dedicated 'Gluten Free & Vegan' page explicitly names gluten-free crusts and vegan Daiya cheese; the 'Order Online' and 'Order By Phone' sections confirm takeout. No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site, leaving all three required criteria unconfirmed.
concerns: OSM name 'Jim's Pizzeria' differs from the business's own branding 'Jim's Pizzeria and Spaghetti House' used consistently throughout the website.
OSM record contains no phone number; website lists 604-793-9333 for the 9218 Young Road location — phone cannot be confirmed against OSM.
Business operates a second Chilliwack location at 7301 Vedder Road (604-858-8611); check for a separate or duplicate OSM node for that location.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate full-service restaurant with a diverse menu including vegan/GF options and takeout, well-suited to touring cyclists, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) are confirmed by available evidence — an on-site visit or direct contact is needed.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Dedicated 'Gluten Free & Vegan' page: gluten-free crusts available in small, medium, and large; vegan Daiya cheese add-on for any pizza or pasta; vegetarian pizza listed on main menu
